issues.issue_hint: An expired account session remains active. Repair the expiry check without rejecting sessions that have not expired.
issues.expected_behavior: At now=1700000000, expiry 1699999999 and expiry 1700000000 return False; expiry 1700000001 returns True.

issues.issue_hint: Catalog pagination skips the first items for a one-based page number. Repair page selection without changing invalid-page handling.
issues.expected_behavior: For [10,20,30,40,50] and page size 2, page 1 returns [10,20] and page 2 returns [30,40].

issues.issue_hint: Checkout subtracts the discount percentage as cents instead of calculating a percentage of the subtotal.
issues.expected_behavior: For a subtotal of 2000 cents, a 25 percent discount returns 1500 cents and a zero percent discount returns 2000 cents.

issues.issue_hint: Stock reservation can return negative inventory when the requested quantity exceeds availability.
issues.expected_behavior: Reserving 4 units from 3 available returns None; reserving exactly 3 from 3 returns 0 remaining.
